Do not rekey the existing SA: a running SA keeps the configuration it was established with, so a rekey renegotiates 3des-md5-prfmd5-modp1024 and the change silently does nothing.   5. [both] Confirm the tunnel is still established on aes256gcm16-prfsha256-curve25519 with the weak proposal gone, and that traffic is still passing.

refusing to probe without authorisation.
